# appdynamics_database_server (Data Source)

Retrieves the detail of one monitored database server by ID. Read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_database_server" "primary" {
  server_id = "512"
}

output "primary_host" {
  value = data.appdynamics_database_server.primary.host
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `config_id` (String) ID of the appdynamics_database_collector that discovered this server.
- `host` (String)
- `internal_name` (String)
- `ip_address` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `node_id` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `role` (String)
- `type` (String)
